r.project: South East Queensland Koala Monitoring Program 2020-2040

r.locality: LOT 11 Duck Creek Road, Kerry QLD 4285, Australia.
r.notes: This koala was captured uing a Lil Acorn remote sensing camera. We have previously recorded a female with a large joey within 200m of this location. We have a relatively large koala population on the farm Jingeri . The farm is 918 acres ajoining Lamington National Park. We are running several conservation and biodiverity monitoring projects. We also have recently gazetted a large Nature Refuge on the more sensitive and intact areas of the farm that have very high species diversity. These areas are designated as high value for ecosystem conservation purposes b the QLD Govt and SEQ Catchments.
